items.name: dashboard-ai-playground
items.title: AI playground
items.description: An AI playground with a sidebar navigation and a main content area. The playground has a header with a settings drawer and a share button. The sidebar has navigation links and a user menu. The main content area shows a form to configure the model and messages.

items.name: dashboard-analytics
items.title: Analytics dashboard
items.description: An application shell with a header and main content area. The header has a navbar, a search input and and a user nav dropdown. The user nav is toggled by a button with an avatar image. The main content area is divided into two rows. The first row has a grid of cards with statistics. The second row has a grid of cards with a table of recent transactions and a list of recent sales.

items.name: dashboard-orders
items.title: Orders dashboard
items.description: An orders dashboard with a sidebar navigation. The sidebar has icon navigation. The content area has a breadcrumb and search in the header. The main area has a list of recent orders with a filter and export button. The main area also has a detailed view of a single order with order details, shipping information, billing information, customer information, and payment information.

items.name: dashboard-product-edit
items.title: Product edit page
items.description: A product edit page. The product edit page has a form to edit the product details, stock, product category, product status, and product images. The product edit page has a sidebar navigation and a main content area. The main content area has a form to edit the product details, stock, product category, product status, and product images. The sidebar navigation has links to product details, stock, product category, product status, and product images.

items.name: dashboard-products
items.title: Products dashboard
items.description: An products dashboard with a sidebar navigation. The sidebar has icon navigation. The content area has a breadcrumb and search in the header. It displays a list of products in a table with actions.

items.name: dashboard-settings
items.title: Settings page
items.description: A settings page. The settings page has a sidebar navigation and a main content area. The main content area has a form to update the store name and a form to update the plugins directory. The sidebar navigation has links to general, security, integrations, support, organizations, and advanced settings.

items.name: dashboard-sidebar
items.title: Dashboard with sidebar
items.description: A products dashboard with a sidebar navigation and a main content area. The dashboard has a header with a search input and a user menu. The sidebar has a logo, navigation links, and a card with a call to action. The main content area shows an empty state with a call to action.

items.name: login-simple
items.title: Simple login
items.description: A simple login form with email and password. The submit button says 'Sign in'.

meta.containerClass: w-full h-screen flex items-center justify-center px-4

items.name: login-social
items.title: Login with social provider
items.description: A login form with email and password. There's an option to login with Google and a link to sign up if you don't have an account.

meta.containerClass: w-full h-screen flex items-center justify-center px-4

items.name: login-split-image
items.title: Login with cover image
items.description: A login page with two columns. The first column has the login form with email and password. There's a Forgot your password link and a link to sign up if you do not have an account. The second column has a cover image.

items.name: signup-card
items.title: Sign up card
items.description: A sign up form with first name, last name, email and password inside a card. There's an option to sign up with GitHub and a link to login if you already have an account

meta.containerClass: w-full h-screen flex items-center justify-center px-4
